page.layout: One printed page. Running text in one main column on the right; marginal notes in the left margin (small italic references such as Gremerus, Caffiodor, Sigebert, Procop., and a note beside "Diacon."). Running head at top centre; page number at top left. Right margin has faint marks, not text.

main_text.l: totum tractum, quo nunc Silesia, Marchia, Prus-
nentur, imperio suo subjecisse & Gneznam civi-
ficdictam, fundasse, dicitur. Quis ipsi successe-
rit, nelcitur: hoc tantum scribunt, Vifimirum ex
Dantiscum, & alias quasdam urbes victo Dano-
rum Rege Sivardo, condidisse. Devenit postea
ad XII Palatinos regimen, quod discordiis distrae-
versibus conscripsit: Dionysius Abbas, qui pala-
suit: Arator, Romanæ Ecclesiæ subdiaconus, qui
Priscianus Cæsariensis, qui Grammaticæ artis pro-
funda rimatus est; Alexander Trallianus Lydus,
medicæ studio Græciam, Tuscism, Galliam, Hi-
Sapiens, Brandanus Scotus, qui septennali naviga-
tione fortunatas insulas requisivit: Procopius, qui
nobis Historiam de bellis Persarum, Vandalorum,
obruti sunt. Pestis ingeminaria, orbi in Italia
